title: blocksmith.lock.v1 — design dependency lock
description: Pins block id → promoted version + contentHash, the way package-lock.json pins npm dependencies. Lives in the customer repository next to DESIGN.md. Agents and CI resolve against this file only — never 'latest markdown'. A lock whose contentHash differs from the live official graph is stale and must be re-pulled.

contentHash.description: Official graph hash at lock time — staleness sentinel.

blocks.description: blockId → pinned { version, contentHash }. Keys sorted for deterministic serialization.

package.description: Links the Pulse npm package build to the promoted graph state.
